title: Holographic Bit Threads from String-Diagrammatic Quantum Information Flow
abstract: Applies Coecke's quantum information flow (categorical QM) to holographic tensor networks: QIF trajectories in the discrete bulk obey the divergence-free and density-bound bit-thread conditions, and bit-thread non-uniqueness corresponds to different protocols for the same distillation task. For stabilizer holographic networks, ZX diagrams show QIF trajectories probe entanglement structure finer than entanglement entropy.
key_claims: QIF trajectories on a holographic tensor network satisfy bit-thread conditions
Bit-thread non-uniqueness corresponds to protocol non-uniqueness for a fixed distillation task
ZX analysis of stabilizer networks resolves structure beyond entanglement entropy
relevance_note: Abstract only. Same first author as the thread-embodiment paper catalogued as PAPER-2026-036 (arXiv:2501.10691). A network-level (not state-level) object, the class RESEARCH-DIRECTOR section 29 and the 2026-09-14 valuable-questions review say this program lacks, but stated for stabilizer networks, not an optimized CFT MERA. WATCH for a MERA version; no HYP-033 bearing now.
